name: spotify-clone
description: Task shortcuts for the whole stack. Each app keeps its own dependencies.

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec api npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:dump: docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dump -U spotify --clean --if-exists --no-owner --no-acl spotify -f /tmp/spotify-db.sql && docker compose cp postgres:/tmp/spotify-db.sql ./backups/spotify-db.sql
scripts.db:restore: docker compose cp ./backups/spotify-db.sql postgres:/tmp/spotify-db.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U spotify -d spotify -f /tmp/spotify-db.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -e SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL -e SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e SEED_ADMIN_NAME api npm run db:seed
